description: This Java source file defines a command handler class for processing withdrawal requests from fixed deposit accounts initiated by applicants within the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses a service component to perform the withdrawal operation, annotated appropriately for Spring framework integration.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountApplicationWithdrawnByApplicantCommandHandler
